question: Which vendors had the highest spending this month?
sql: SELECT v.id,v.name,SUM(i.total) AS total_spend FROM vendors v JOIN invoices i ON i.vendorId=v.id WHERE i.invoiceDate >= date_trunc('month',CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY v.id,v.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC LIMIT 10

question: Show high risk invoices.
sql: SELECT i.id,i.invoiceNumber,i.total,t.riskLevel FROM invoices i JOIN transactions t ON t.invoiceId=i.id WHERE t.riskLevel IN ('HIGH','CRITICAL')

question: How much potential financial leakage was detected?
sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(potentialLeakage),0) AS potential_leakage FROM transactions
